#!/bin/bash

# PropScan Installation Script

set -e

INSTALL_DIR="/opt/propscan"
BIN_DIR="/usr/local/bin"
DESKTOP_DIR="/usr/share/applications"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_status() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

check_root() {
    if [[ $EUID -eq 0 ]]; then
        print_error "This script should not be run as root for security reasons."
        print_status "Please run as a regular user. The script will prompt for sudo when needed."
        exit 1
    fi
}

check_dependencies() {
    print_status "Checking dependencies..."
    
    # Check for Python 3
    if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        print_error "Python 3 is required but not installed."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check for pip
    if ! command -v pip3 &> /dev/null && ! command -v pip &> /dev/null; then
        print_error "pip is required but not installed."
        print_status "Please install python3-pip package."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    print_success "Dependencies check passed."
}

install_propscan() {
    print_status "Installing PropScan..."
    
    # Install using pip
    if command -v pip3 &> /dev/null; then
        pip3 install --user -e .
    else
        pip install --user -e .
    fi
    
    print_success "PropScan installed successfully!"
}

create_desktop_entry() {
    print_status "Creating desktop entry..."
    
    # Get the user's local applications directory
    LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/applications"
    mkdir -p "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR"
    
    cat > "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR/propscan.desktop" << EOF
[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=PropScan
Comment=Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems
Exec=propscan
Icon=security-high
Terminal=true
Categories=System;Security;
Keywords=proprietary;software;scan;package;manager;
EOF
    
    print_success "Desktop entry created."
}

show_usage() {
    print_success "Installation completed!"
    echo
    print_status "Usage examples:"
    echo "  propscan                    # Scan all package managers"
    echo "  propscan -m flatpak         # Scan only Flatpak"
    echo "  propscan -f json            # Output as JSON"
    echo "  propscan --list-managers    # List available package managers"
    echo "  propscan --help             # Show help"
    echo
    print_status "You may need to restart your terminal or run:"
    echo "  source ~/.bashrc"
    echo
}

main() {
    echo "PropScan Installation Script"
    echo "============================"
    echo
    
    check_root
    check_dependencies
    install_propscan
    create_desktop_entry
    show_usage
}

main "$@"
